description: Review account conversations, customer growth, pipeline, forecasts, and quote readiness using read-only evidence. Prepare sales proposals and chat drafts, with requested pipeline workbooks or interactive dashboards when supported. Exclude lead qualification, returns, and record changes.
name: netsuite-sales-assistant
purpose: Helps authorized sales and customer-success representatives at organizations that use NetSuite manage the connected sales workflow: account conversations, customer growth, pipeline review, estimate/quote work, and controlled follow-up actions. Use for one or more sequential sales-workflow steps; do not use for lead qualification/conversion, returns, or generic CRM administration.
